content.name: Danielle Okafor
content.title: Charge Nurse, Progressive Care (RN, PCCN)
content.summary: Registered nurse with eight years in med-surg, telemetry and progressive care at Austin-area hospitals, now charging a 32-bed step-down unit. PCCN-certified and known for cutting rapid-response calls on my unit by 22% through an early-warning huddle I designed with our nurse educator.

experience.title: Staff Nurse (RN), Medical-Surgical
bullets: Managed a 5–6 patient assignment on a 36-bed adult med-surg floor, covering post-op orthopedic, GI bleed and diabetic patients across 12-hour day and night shifts.
Joined the unit falls committee and introduced hourly purposeful rounding scripts, helping reduce patient falls from 11 to 6 over one fiscal year.
Precepted 4 new-graduate nurses through 12-week orientations; all four completed their residency year on the unit.

experience.title: Registered Nurse, Cardiac Telemetry
bullets: Interpreted continuous cardiac rhythms for up to 5 telemetry patients and escalated arrhythmias using ACLS algorithms, including 9 bedside codes as first responder.
Served as a COVID-surge float nurse for 7 months, staffing ICU overflow under a team-nursing model alongside critical care RNs.
Rewrote the heparin drip titration cheat sheet with pharmacy, which cut aPTT-related dose errors flagged in Epic from 14 per quarter to 4.
Raised unit HCAHPS 'nurse communication' scores from the 61st to the 78th percentile as co-lead of a bedside shift-report rollout.

experience.title: Charge Nurse, Progressive Care Unit
bullets: Coordinate staffing, bed flow and admissions for a 32-bed step-down unit with 9–11 RNs and 4 patient care techs per shift.
Designed a 10-minute early-warning huddle using MEWS scores at 0700 and 1900, contributing to a 22% drop in rapid-response activations within a year.
Shortened ED-to-unit admission time by 41 minutes on average by pre-assigning beds during bed-management calls and standardizing handoff via SBAR.
Lead monthly skills fairs on chest tubes, insulin drips and telemetry troubleshooting for 45 unit nurses.

education.school: The University of Texas at Austin

achievements.title: RN License, Texas Board of Nursing
achievements.detail: Multistate license under the Nurse Licensure Compact; passed NCLEX-RN on first attempt, 2018.

achievements.title: DAISY Award nominee
achievements.detail: Nominated twice by patients' families for compassionate care during end-of-life transitions on telemetry.
